title: Mango Makhana Kheer
steps: Do not use sugar for this recipe since the cals will shoot up (can alter the qty of stevia/monkfruit extract based on preference)
Roast makhana and almonds on low flame for 6-7 mins until makhana is crispy.
Grind almonds and half the qty of makhana (don’t make a fine powder)

In a pan, add 1 ltr milk (already boiled) and keep the flame medium-low. Keep stirring every 2 mins so the milk does not stick to the bottom. It will take 15-20 mins or more for the milk to reduce in qty. Once the milk qty reduces a little, add the powdered makhana and almonds. Also add chiraunji seeds, elaichi powder and raisins. Stir for 2 minutes and add the stevia/monkfruit extract.
Keep stirring and cook for another 5 minutes and then add the whole roasted makhanas we kept aside.
Let it cook on low flame for 10 minutes while stirring every minute. Feel free to add some boiling milk to adjust consistency.
Once the kheer is ready, let it cool completely and then add the mango pulp. Mix well and set it in the fridge for an hour.
Garnish with rose petals and almonds and dig in!

flags.note: No protein source reaches 35 % of the protein (CONTEXT §4), so it has no main protein.
